{{Quote|I trust you've heard that the assassins have been identified as members of the Nebula Front. The few that managed to escape were traced to Asmeru, a world on the edge of the Senex sector.|[[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="CoD" />}}
'''Asmeru''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], on the border with the [[Hadar sector/Legends|Hadar sector]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The planet once supported great cities and grand palaces, but all those fell victim to sudden climatic change. The current population is comprised of Ossan slaves created on the Vandron world of Karfeddion, but banished here owing to defects of one sort or another. Bred for agricultural work, the slaves have managed to make a life for themselves, though we doubt that you will find them especially welcoming.|A representative of [[House Vandron]]|<ref name="CoD" />}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was very [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]],<ref name="TEA" /> and had been populated by some [[Unidentified Asmeru species|form of civilization]] in the past, as evidenced by the numerous ruins that dot Asmeru's surface.<ref name="CoD" />

Near Asmeru was a [[Gravity/Legends|gravitic]] sink known as the [[Asmeru Anomaly]], which could be dangerous for unwary [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|Nevertheless, the Outer Rim worlds are now in turmoil. Even those who don't openly support the Nebula Front are decrying the fact that the Republic took it upon itself to intercede at Asmeru.|[[Bor Gracus]], to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="CoD" />}}
The planet was was controlled by [[Ancient Houses|Houses]] [[House Vandron|Vandron]] and [[House Elegin/Legends|Elegin]].<ref name="TEA" />

Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Asmeru was the headquarters of the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]], which surrounded the planet with a dangerous [[Mine/Legends|minefield]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] were eventually defeated by an [[Mission to Asmeru|attack]] of [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Judicial/Legends|Judicials]].<ref name="CoD" />

The planet remained neutral during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="FF139">{{FactFile|139|WOR 1-2|Worlds of the Clone Wars}}</ref>
